note: Questions for the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (documents/ipc.pdf). Each expected section was checked against the parsed index rather than recalled, so the annotation matches the text actually indexed. Questions are phrased the way a person would ask them, deliberately avoiding the section's own heading words, because reusing the heading measures keyword overlap rather than semantic retrieval.
